content: The AI Platform API Gateway accepts chat requests over HTTP and authenticates them with an API key header.
Chat requests are published to a Kafka-compatible topic and processed asynchronously by the workflow engine.
The workflow engine retries failed processing with exponential backoff before routing poison messages to a dead letter queue.
The LLM orchestrator generates responses using a self-hosted Ollama model and opens a circuit breaker after repeated failures.
The demo tenant is used for synthetic health-check and monitoring traffic during the evaluation period.
